nusmp.page.book_star.quartile_scutum: Four of your stars join into a standing barrier of starlight, up to 6 by 5 blocks, for 5 seconds: arrows, fireballs and spell bolts of everyone who is not on your side stop on it until it has taken three hits' worth of damage (a devil's magic counts half). Open to every Star mage. Your stars stay.
nusmp.page.book_star.quartile_hasta: Four stars link and gather their light for a moment, then fire it from their middle as a spear of light with a laser tail along your crosshair (32 blocks, up to 6 foes pierced, a little knockback). The four stars are used up. Open to every Star mage; a Grinberryall heir's spear hits harder.
nusmp.page.book_star.quintile_atrum_scut: Quintile: Atrum Scutum (unverified canon: one source only). Five of your stars form a wider barrier, up to 8 by 6 blocks, for 7 seconds, that can take four and a half hits' worth of damage. Needs five real stars. Open to every Star mage. Your stars stay.
nusmp.page.book_star.quintile_atrum_hast: Quintile: Atrum Hasta (unverified canon: one source only). Five stars gather their light into a heavier spear of light, 1.6 blocks wide, up to 8 foes pierced. All five stars are used up. Needs five real stars. Open to every Star mage; a Grinberryall heir's spear hits harder.
nusmp.page.book_star.quintile_atrum_flag: Quintile: Atrum Flagellum (unverified canon: one source only). A whip of starlight lashes through five of your stars three times; each foe on its path can be hit twice. Needs five real stars. Open to every Star mage. Your stars stay.
